data.title: 羽毛笔 · 吧台闭店后的羽梢微阖
data.action: 缩在吧台角落的软皮沙发里，双手抱着抱枕昏昏欲睡，金色短发凌乱搭在额前，羽毛般的眼睫轻颤，揉着眼睛轻唤。
data.location: 深夜打烊后的小酒馆后室，暖色调木桌上散落着几个空酒杯与一盘小坚果
data.timeOfDay: 凌晨两点酒保打烊之后
data.lighting: 吧台顶上一盏孤零零的暖橙色小射灯，将昏暗的小酒馆烘托得如归宿般温暖
data.mood: 天然呆少女的极度困倦与信赖，安心、静谧而充满软糯感
data.description: 深夜打烊后的小酒馆后室，暖色调木桌上散落着几个空酒杯与一盘小坚果。缩在吧台角落的软皮沙发里，双手抱着抱枕昏昏欲睡，金色短发凌乱搭在额前，羽毛般的眼睫轻颤，揉着眼睛轻唤。 她微微抬眸轻语——“博士……今天店里打烊了哦。羽毛笔……好困……可以借你的肩膀靠一会儿吗……”
data.promptProse: Curled drowsily inside a deep leather booth in the back room of a closed tavern after hours, La Pluma wears a dusty-lilac crinkled chiffon strapless tube slip dress edged with feathery white lace trim. Hugging a soft pillow while rubbing one sleepy eye beside empty glasses on the wooden table, she rests in a single warm amber spotlight.
data.animaCaption: Curled sleepily into the corner of a dark leather tavern booth in a dusty-lilac lace-trimmed strapless chiffon slip, she hugs a throw pillow and rubs one drowsy eye beside empty bar glasses. A lone warm overhead amber spotlight softens the closed barroom.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a dusty-lilac crinkled chiffon strapless tube slip dress topped with feathery white lace ruffles along its shirred bodice.
